notes: One detached squared-paper leaf with seven handwritten work-list entries. The first concerns weak Lefschetz without assuming X and Y smooth, with X-Y smooth; the following entries concern a coefficient-sheaf definition in terms of champ associé, restating SGA 4 notions in coefficient-sheaf language, constructions in the relatively smooth case, projective adic systems in derived categories, a warning about overly particular coefficients, and an identity involving D and the generic-point inclusion. These are statements or tasks on the page, not results verified by this reader. There is no separate title, date, or secure author page number. The repeated SGA 5 and exposé numerals serve as item headings. The lower-left 51 is recorded only as the archive sheet number. The page is one scanned leaf; no total page count is written. The author’s explicit tentative directions include Essayer de faire and the alternative placement (ou dans thèse); the raised mark over ou has no resolved reference on this sheet. No explicit author question mark or proof-status note is securely read. The packet alone is not used to establish the name of the handwriting, hence the inventory says unnamed hand. Two faint nonlexical traces below the thèse parenthesis are reproduced with doubt marks rather than read as words. The whole image and the two provided halves were each viewed once, in the prescribed order, followed by one view of each of 21 unique crops. No whole half was reopened or enlarged; no OCR, external research, other page, or other reader output was consulted. diff_c is true for resolved, reordered, or newly introduced uncertainty as well as changed letters or omitted marks; unchanged retained C doubts have diff_c false. H’s different macro names alone are not counted as differences. No proof, calculation, or external background check was performed. Structural validation passed for required JSON keys, allowed decision kinds, bounding boxes, all crop paths, single-backslash LaTeX decoding, 15 C doubt locations, and balanced TeX braces. A LuaLaTeX syntax compilation was attempted, but the installed engine could not find lualatex.fmt; no successful compilation is claimed.
math_reading_decisions: The first occurrence of the generic-point letter retains eta|y. The four later occurrences are written eta without repeating the mark, as required for a recurring ambiguous glyph; each H difference is separately located.
The separator after i is not silently changed to the usual colon. Its connected angled strokes are transcribed as <|:|membership, with the angle first.
The exponent in the coefficient parenthesis is retained as nu|n because the written small character has an angular descending/rising profile. The meaning of the quotient was not used to force n.

The first and last Z in the coefficient parenthesis show doubled diagonals. The central Z before the division slash has a separate alphabet doubt, plain Z|blackboard Z, from that occurrence’s own strokes.
The final equation has ordinary single-stem D and F, two stars below and to the right of i, and the two nested parenthesis pairs as written. It was transcribed, not proved.
The arrow in the last prose line has a long horizontal shaft and a right-hand head. The first entry has a plain short subtraction dash in X-Y.

The Roman headings preserve their visible upper and lower rules; the later V is left without those rules. The cancelled numeral remains struck and uncertain, and the replacement VI is below it within its open U-shaped curve.
Two horizontal strokes after the last coefficient Z are retained as two dashes, rather than normalized to an ellipsis.
